result.instructions: Tools for Increase, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Increase data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run increase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run increase_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run increase_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. increase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: increase_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List bank accounts. Increase API: GET /accounts. Filter by entity and status (sent as status.in).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

status.description: Account status filter (sent as status.in), e.g. open | closed.

entity_id.description: Only accounts belonging to this entity id.

tools.name: increase_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Retrieve a single bank account by id. Increase API: GET /accounts/{account_id}.

tools.name: increase_get_account_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Retrieve an account's current and available balance. Increase API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/balance. Optionally as of a point in time.

at_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to get the balance as of that moment (query param at_time).

tools.name: increase_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List settled transactions. Increase API: GET /transactions. Filter by account, category (sent as category.in), and created date range (created_at.after / created_at.before).

account_id.description: Only transactions for this account id.

created_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only transactions created at/after this (sent as created_at.after).

created_before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only transactions created before this (sent as created_at.before).

tools.name: increase_create_external_account
tools.title: Create external account
tools.description: Registers an external (counterparty) bank account in Increase for future transfers. This creates a record only — it MOVES NO MONEY. Increase API: POST /external_accounts.

description.description: A human-readable description/name for this external account.

funding.description: The type of the destination account. Default checking.

account_holder.description: The type of entity that owns the external account.
